study.title: Choosing a clearer onboarding promise
study.businessDecision: Decide which onboarding promise should lead the next launch.

analysis.summary: Teams value faster orientation, but trust depends on visible control and evidence.

findings.title: Fast orientation is the strongest initial value signal
findings.narrative: Seven of nine participants described the first useful summary as the moment the product became valuable.

findings.title: Review controls turn speed into trust
findings.narrative: Participants accepted automation when they could inspect sources and revise the output before sharing.

findings.title: Enterprise teams need a slower proof step
findings.narrative: Security and research leaders asked for methodology detail before relying on a generated recommendation.
